notes: Routing eval: for each phrase, a host that sees this skill's description among others should load it (should_fire) or not (should_not_fire). 'why' records the intended reason so a grader can tell a defensible miss from a wrong one.

should_fire.phrase: spawn an agent to refactor the payments module while I keep working
run these three migrations in parallel, each in its own branch
get codex to review my diff before I merge
can I get a second opinion on this design from a different model?
should_fire.why: second opinion without naming codex; cross-engine

check on the child sessions I started earlier
what happened to my agents after the reboot?

have codex implement it and claude judge the result
fan this audit out across the five services but keep it under a dollar
run a subagent in its own worktree so it doesn't touch my changes
research the options, then implement the simplest, then run the tests, as a pipeline
let claude and codex argue about this API design and tell me where they disagree
have a child agent produce the endpoint list as JSON matching this schema
the codex child hit a rate limit, queue the retry for when it resets
make an agent fix the lint errors and only count it done if make lint passes
